In a dynamic, cloud-first environment, you will implement security controls, assess risk, and strengthen monitoring and response processes, while helping shape security policies and influencing teams across the organization. Duties & Responsibilities Partner with the security engineering team and adjacent IT teams to conduct security reviews, provide hardening recommendations, and implement security controls across company IT assets. Monitor emerging threats, assess threat intelligence, and apply security solutions that strengthen the company's security posture. Administer and tune endpoint and email security tools to prevent, detect, and respond to threats. Support and enhance vulnerability management, including identification, tracking, and remediation, to maintain comprehensive visibility across on-premises and cloud infrastructure and services. Participate in security incident response and the on-call rotation for events involving supported infrastructure and applications. Develop and maintain security standards, runbooks, and technical documentation. Work with company leadership, IT management, and teams across the business to deliver security awareness efforts and promote a security-first culture. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Information Technology or similar 2-4 Years of experience in Software Development, IT Systems Administration and/or Cyber Security Certifications such as CompTIA Security+/CySA+, ISC2 SSCP, AWS Cloud/Security Certifications, and/or ISC2 CISSP are a plus. Competencies Understanding of firewalls, SIEM, antivirus, and IDS/IPS concepts. Ability to identify and mitigate network vulnerabilities and explain how to avoid them. Effective communicator, positive attitude, a dedicated team player Work Environment & Physical Requirements Performs sedentary work in an office environment with limited lifting (less than 10 pounds) or walking required. Through your close monitoring and follow-up, you ensure that our operational infrastructure functions optimally. Depending on your experience and interests, you can work as a generalist or choose to specialise further. Register and analyse issues and, through targeted questioning, gather as much additional information as possible. Based on this information, you provide a fast and customer-focused solution. Dutch is your native language and you are fluent in English. Excellent spelling and written communication come naturally to you. You are analytical, detail-oriented and results-driven.
